lines.text: In our village, nobody checks the weather forecast on a smartphone.
Look at that crow flying sideways! In five minutes, a massive storm is coming!
Rahat immediately panicked and rushed to fill every bucket at the tube well.
Why are you sweating like a madman under the afternoon sun?
Chacha said his joints are aching, and that always means heavy rain!
Chacha's joints only ache when the tea bill is about to arrive.
And just like that, the storm never came... and neither did Chacha's money.
